name: flow/member/call/binding dot
context: expression, receiver-first call and terminal binding
operand_rule: receiver or value followed by a valid member, call, pipeline stage or binding terminal
result_rule: member/call result, transformed receiver, or a new binding
failure_policy: type/resolution error before codegen; no hidden fallback
description: The visual and semantic center of Nebo: member access, fluent call, pipeline continuation and value-first binding are decided by parser context.

name: grouping and call delimiters
operand_rule: groupable expression or callable plus typed arguments
evaluation: callee once, arguments left-to-right exactly once
failure_policy: arity/type/effect diagnostics; no call on failure
description: Groups expressions and invokes callables. Nested calls reuse the general expression grammar.

name: block delimiters
context: function, control-flow, match, struct and domain bodies
result_rule: block value only where a construct defines one
description: Delimits lexical blocks and structured bodies; the lexer does not assign a single semantic meaning.

name: array/list/type delimiters
context: Array literals, bounded collection forms and type syntax
result_rule: Array/collection/type value; general indexing is separately RESERVED
failure_policy: bounds and shape diagnostics; no partial aggregate
description: The delimiters are core. General `expr[index]` semantics are not implied by their presence.

name: generic type argument delimiters
operand_rule: generic type constructor plus valid type arguments
description: Angle brackets in type context are distinct from relational operators in expression context.

name: separator
context: arguments, elements, fields, bindings and tuples
description: Comma is a separator, never a free expression operator.

name: statement terminator
description: Terminates statements. It is not an operator and cannot be overloaded.

name: typed/named separator
context: type annotations, named arguments, fields and schemas
operand_rule: name/type or name/value according to context
failure_policy: context-specific diagnostic; `=` is not a named-argument separator
description: Separates names from types or values. It is not the C ternary separator in the canonical language.

name: return-type and match-arm arrow
operand_rule: signature type relation or pattern/body relation
result_rule: type declaration or selected arm result
failure_policy: invalid-context diagnostic; member-arrow meaning is rejected
description: The current Assembly language uses `->` for bounded match arms and return-type context; it is not pointer member access.

name: wildcard and ignored binding
result_rule: no bound value unless a future pattern says otherwise
description: Matches or ignores without introducing a normal binding.

name: line comment introducer
operand_rule: any source bytes until newline or EOF
failure_policy: none unless encoding/source controls are invalid
description: Begins a line comment. It also permanently prevents `//` from becoming integer division.

name: addition
operand_rule: same-type numeric operands or an explicitly registered Add protocol with no implicit unsafe coercion
failure_policy: checked overflow by default; invalid type rejected
description: Adds numeric values. Text concatenation is not implicit and belongs to the domain-gated `⧺` operator.

name: subtraction
operand_rule: same-type numeric operands or Subtract protocol
description: Subtracts the right operand from the left.

name: multiplication
operand_rule: same-type numeric operands or Multiply protocol
description: Scalar multiplication. Vector cross, Cartesian product and tensor products use distinct domain symbols.

name: division
operand_rule: compatible numeric operands; no implicit Int/Float coercion unless a future numeric policy explicitly allows it
result_rule: Int for Int/Int; Float for supported Float profiles
failure_policy: division-by-zero and signed overflow checked; Int division truncates toward zero
description: Preserves the Assembly compiler decision: signed integer division truncates toward zero.

name: remainder
operand_rule: Int operands in the current profile; future types require a Remainder protocol
failure_policy: zero divisor checked; result obeys the signed division identity
description: In infix position `%` means remainder. Template placeholders and postfix percentage are separate contexts.

name: power
operand_rule: Power protocol; initial core profiles Int^nonnegative-Int and Float-compatible powers
failure_policy: checked overflow/domain policy; negative Int exponent requires explicit promotion
description: Canonical exponentiation. It is intentionally not XOR.

name: unary plus
description: Explicit numeric identity, primarily useful for generated and mathematical source.

name: unary negation
operand_rule: signed numeric operand or Negate protocol
failure_policy: checked overflow for minimum signed integer
description: Negates a value. Power binds more tightly: `-2 ^ 2` means `-(2 ^ 2)`.

name: logical NOT
description: Boolean negation. Postfix factorial is a separate domain-gated context.

name: logical AND
evaluation: left once; right only when left is true
description: Short-circuit conjunction.

name: logical OR
evaluation: left once; right only when left is false
description: Short-circuit disjunction.

name: typed XOR
result_rule: Bool, Int or Bytes matching the operand domain
failure_policy: type/length mismatch rejected; no padding or truncation
description: Canonical XOR spelling. Existing `bitXor()` remains an exact method form.

name: less than
description: Strict ordering. Chained comparisons are rejected; use explicit conjunction.

name: less than or equal
description: Inclusive upper-order comparison.

name: greater than
description: Strict reverse ordering.

name: greater than or equal
description: Inclusive lower-order comparison.

name: equality
operand_rule: same Eq domain; no implicit cross-type coercion
description: Typed equality. Current-head Char uniformity must be replayed before extending claims.

name: inequality
description: Logical negation of typed equality without re-evaluating operands.

name: three-way comparison
description: Returns a typed Ordering rather than an Int sentinel.

name: assignment statement
context: statement to an existing mutable lvalue
evaluation: target once, RHS once, one store on success
description: Assignment never creates a new binding and is not equality.

name: checked add assignment
context: statement to an existing mutable numeric lvalue
operand_rule: mutable lvalue supporting Add and compatible RHS
evaluation: target once, old value once, RHS once, one store on success
failure_policy: checked overflow; zero store on failure
description: Compound assignment with exactly-once lvalue and RHS evaluation.

name: checked subtract assignment
context: statement to an existing mutable numeric lvalue
evaluation: target once, old value once, RHS once, one store on success
failure_policy: checked overflow; zero store on failure
description: Checked subtraction assignment.

name: checked multiply assignment
context: statement to an existing mutable numeric lvalue
evaluation: target once, old value once, RHS once, one store on success
failure_policy: checked overflow; zero store on failure
description: Future checked multiplication assignment.

name: checked divide assignment
context: statement to an existing mutable numeric lvalue
evaluation: target once, old value once, RHS once, one store on success
failure_policy: zero divisor/overflow checked; zero store on failure
description: Future checked division assignment.

name: checked remainder assignment
context: statement to an existing mutable Int-like lvalue
evaluation: target once, old value once, RHS once, one store on success
failure_policy: zero divisor checked; zero store on failure
description: Future checked remainder assignment.

name: checked power assignment
context: statement to an existing mutable power-capable lvalue
evaluation: target once, old value once, exponent once, one store on success
failure_policy: overflow/domain checked; zero store on failure
description: Power assignment; XOR assignment uses no `^=` interpretation.

name: Result propagation
context: postfix on Result in a compatible Result-returning context
operand_rule: Result<T,E> with an enclosing compatible Result<_,E>
result_rule: T on Ok; early return of the exact E on Err
evaluation: operand once; cleanup exactly once before early return
failure_policy: type/context mismatch diagnostic; no artifact on rejection
description: Propagates typed Result errors. It is not a ternary marker.

name: Option coalescing
operand_rule: Option<T> on the left and a T-compatible fallback on the right
evaluation: left once; fallback only for None
description: Returns the contained value or lazily evaluates the fallback.

name: Option-safe member/call chain
operand_rule: Option<T> followed by a valid T member or call
evaluation: receiver once; member/call only for Some
description: Safe Option chaining; it does not catch arbitrary errors.

name: assign when None
operand_rule: mutable Option<T> lvalue and T-compatible RHS
evaluation: target once; RHS only when None; one store on success
description: Conditionally initializes a mutable Option without duplicating target evaluation.

name: typed percentage
context: immediately after a numeric expression without an intervening operator
operand_rule: exact numeric literal/value accepted by Percent constructor
failure_policy: range policy is type-defined; never silently becomes raw Float
description: Postfix `%` constructs a typed Percent. Infix `%` remains remainder.

name: inclusive range
failure_policy: invalid direction/step handled by Range policy
description: Uses the single ellipsis U+2026 so ASCII `..` remains available for lateral flow.

name: range excluding end
result_rule: Range<T> including start and excluding end
description: Half-open range `[start,end)`.

name: range excluding start
result_rule: Range<T> excluding start and including end
description: Half-open range `(start,end]`.

name: exclusive range
description: Open range `(start,end)`.

name: lateral flow/tap
context: expression followed by a lateral block
operand_rule: any receiver; first profile lends a shared read-only view to the block
evaluation: receiver once; block once; block result discarded
failure_policy: move/escape/mutation conflicts rejected; no hidden parallelism
description: Observes or derives from a value without replacing the main pipeline receiver.

name: Unicode minus
description: U+2212 is an exact source alias for ASCII hyphen-minus in operator context.

name: Unicode division
description: U+00F7 aliases `/`; U+2215 and other slash confusables do not.

name: Unicode less-or-equal
description: Exact alias for `<=`.

name: Unicode greater-or-equal
description: Exact alias for `>=`.

name: Unicode not-equal
description: Exact alias for `!=`; it is not symbolic inequivalence beyond typed inequality.

name: Unicode logical AND
description: Exact short-circuit alias for `&&`.

name: Unicode logical OR
description: Exact short-circuit alias for `||`.

name: Unicode logical NOT
description: Exact alias for prefix logical `!`.

name: Unicode XOR
description: Exact alias for the canonical ASCII keyword `xor`.

name: square root
operand_rule: Sqrt protocol or supported numeric/symbolic type
description: Square-root operator; negative real input never silently becomes an untyped NaN.

name: cube root
description: Cube root with exact/approximate behavior determined by the numeric type.

name: fourth root
description: Fourth root.

name: factorial
operand_rule: nonnegative integral domain or Factorial protocol
failure_policy: negative input and overflow rejected or returned as typed failure
description: Postfix factorial; prefix `!` remains core logical NOT.

name: typed infinity literal
context: extended numeric, interval and calculus profiles
result_rule: Float infinity, unbounded interval endpoint or symbolic infinity
description: Infinity is contextual and never a universal untyped value.

name: pi constant
description: Unicode constant alias with an ASCII `PI` name in the math module.

name: tau constant
description: Circle constant equal to two pi in the selected precision domain.

name: summation binder
operand_rule: finite iterable plus a summable mapped expression
evaluation: domain once; iteration order explicit and deterministic by default
failure_policy: overflow, cancellation and floating reduction policy explicit
description: Summation with a dedicated binder grammar; it never hides nondeterministic parallel reduction.

name: product binder
failure_policy: checked overflow and empty-domain identity policy
description: Product reduction.

name: value with symmetric uncertainty
operand_rule: compatible scalar value and nonnegative uncertainty
failure_policy: invalid uncertainty rejected; propagation policy explicit
description: Constructs a typed uncertain value, not an implicit tuple of two branches.

name: approximate equality
operand_rule: comparable approximate domain plus explicit tolerance or an uncertainty-bearing type
description: Approximate equality is valid only with explicit tolerance or intrinsic uncertainty.

name: not approximately equal
description: Typed negation of approximate equality.

name: symbolic or structural equivalence
operand_rule: symbolic expressions or explicitly registered equivalence domain
description: Represents semantic/symbolic equivalence, distinct from runtime typed equality.

name: divides
description: Tests divisibility.

name: does not divide
description: Negates divisibility.

name: floor delimiters
description: Mathematical floor delimiters.

name: ceiling delimiters
description: Mathematical ceiling delimiters.

name: proportional to
operand_rule: symbolic expressions, quantities or datasets with a declared proportionality model
description: Creates or tests a typed proportionality relation.

name: degree suffix
description: Constructs a typed angle, never a plain number.

name: per-mille suffix
description: Typed per-mille ratio.

name: basis-point suffix
description: Typed basis-point ratio.

name: Celsius suffix
description: Constructs an affine Celsius temperature.

name: Fahrenheit suffix
description: Constructs an affine Fahrenheit temperature.

name: membership
description: Tests whether a value belongs to a set or explicitly opted-in collection.

name: non-membership
description: Negates membership.

name: set union
description: Returns the union without mutating either operand.

name: set intersection
description: Returns the intersection.

name: set difference
description: Elements of the left set that are not in the right.

name: symmetric difference
description: Elements present in exactly one operand.

name: subset or equal
description: Inclusive subset relation.

name: proper subset
description: Strict subset relation.

name: superset or equal
description: Inclusive superset relation.

name: proper superset
description: Strict superset relation.

name: Cartesian product
evaluation: left then right once; pair order deterministic
description: Cartesian product. In vector context the same code point means cross product via type-directed domain resolution.

name: empty set literal
operand_rule: context supplies the element type or an explicit type is required
description: Typed empty set.

name: dot/inner scalar product
operand_rule: compatible vectors or algebraic structures with DotProduct
description: Dot product or type-declared inner scalar product.

name: vector cross product
description: Cross product selected by the vector domain, not scalar multiplication.

name: Hadamard product
description: Elementwise product.

name: tensor/Kronecker product
description: Tensor or Kronecker product according to operand types.

name: direct sum
description: Direct sum.

name: transpose
description: Postfix transpose.

name: adjoint
description: Conjugate transpose/adjoint.

name: inverse
result_rule: Result<T, SingularError> or exact inverse type
description: Postfix inverse; never silently produces invalid numeric data.

name: norm delimiters
failure_policy: norm kind/default must be declared by type/profile
description: Mathematical norm delimiters.

name: inner product delimiters
operand_rule: compatible values in a declared inner-product space
description: Inner-product notation.

name: function/operator composition
operand_rule: output of right callable compatible with input of left callable
evaluation: construction operands once; invocation follows callable order
description: Creates `f ∘ g`, which invokes g before f.

name: orthogonality
operand_rule: vectors/subspaces with explicit tolerance or exact domain
description: Tests orthogonality.

name: parallel relation
operand_rule: vectors/lines with explicit tolerance or exact domain
description: Tests geometric parallelism.

name: integral binder
operand_rule: integrable callable/expression, explicit variable/domain, method and tolerance
evaluation: domain and integrand follow the integration plan
description: Single integral. A naked Float result without convergence/error metadata is not the canonical contract.

name: double integral binder
description: Double integral.

name: triple integral binder
description: Triple integral.

name: contour integral binder
description: Contour integral.

name: partial derivative
description: Partial derivative.

name: gradient
operand_rule: scalar field over a declared coordinate space
description: Gradient.

name: divergence
description: Divergence; maximal-munch compound token in calculus context.

name: curl
operand_rule: three-dimensional vector field or declared curl domain
description: Curl/rotational.

name: Laplacian
description: Laplacian.

name: distributed as
description: Declares or states a distributional relation.

name: probabilistic independence
description: Independence relation.

name: conditional probability separator
operand_rule: event/expression pair inside a probability construct
failure_policy: outside the probability grammar it is not activated
description: Separates event and condition only inside a dedicated probability grammar.

name: universal quantifier
operand_rule: finite or proof-bounded domain plus predicate
evaluation: domain once; predicate under solver rules
description: Universal quantification.

name: existential quantifier
operand_rule: finite or proof-bounded domain plus predicate
description: Existential quantification.

name: non-existence quantifier
operand_rule: finite or proof-bounded domain plus predicate
description: States that no witness exists.

name: logical implication
evaluation: left once; right may be solver-lazy, never ordinary hidden effects
description: Implication, separate from graph arrows and match arrows.

name: logical equivalence
description: If-and-only-if relation.

name: provability relation
description: Syntactic derivability/provability.

name: semantic satisfaction
description: Semantic satisfaction.

name: NAND
description: Boolean NAND; unlike `&&`, it does not short-circuit.

name: NOR
description: Boolean NOR; unlike `||`, it does not short-circuit.

name: directed relation/edge
description: Directed graph edge. It is not the ASCII `->` match/signature separator.

name: bidirectional relation/edge
description: Bidirectional graph relation.

name: asynchronous/dataflow edge
evaluation: construction only; runtime effects declared separately
description: Asynchronous or dataflow connection.

name: state transition
description: State transition notation.

name: Text concatenation
description: Unambiguous Text concatenation without numeric coercion.

name: pattern/regex match
result_rule: Bool or MatchResult depending on explicit form
failure_policy: step/depth/memory budgets; catastrophic pattern fails closed
description: Bounded pattern match.

name: pattern/regex non-match
description: Negated bounded pattern match.

name: Text interpolation
operand_rule: pure expression accepted by the interpolation profile
description: Syntax B from RF84; lowers to the same FormatPlan as `.format(...)`.

name: typed format placeholders
operand_rule: placeholder/argument types and counts must match
failure_policy: compile-time for literal templates; Result for dynamic templates
description: Percent tokens inside a format template are not arithmetic `%` operators.

name: Slash render directive
operand_rule: registered bounded directive and validated body/options
failure_policy: unknown directive policy explicit; anti-Turing limits
description: Semantic rendering directive; outside a Slash template `/` remains division.

name: annotation/metadata introducer
evaluation: compile-time only unless the annotation explicitly declares generated runtime metadata
description: Introduces typed metadata; it is never a free arithmetic operator.

name: reverse flow
description: Historical parse-only idea; no executable semantics are frozen in this registry.

name: bidirectional flow/binding
description: Reserved until synchronization, ownership, causality and failure semantics are separately frozen.

name: ellipsis/spread/rest/varargs
description: Does not activate spread, rest, varargs or a range.

name: qualified path separator
description: Reserved because current modules do not require a second public path syntax.

name: hash-prefixed syntax
description: Held for one future purpose only; no implicit debug, comment, color or template semantics.

name: hash Color literal
failure_policy: stable reserved diagnostic and quick fix
description: Reserved until a dedicated lexer contract exists; explicit `Color.hex()` remains the safe form.

name: dollar syntax outside interpolation
description: Only `${...}` inside an interpolation-enabled Text literal may eventually use dollar.

name: backtick literal/template
description: Reserved until raw, multiline and tagged literal grammar is frozen.

name: block comment
description: Line comments are canonical; block comments remain reserved, not silently ignored.

name: infix bitwise AND
description: Existing method-based bitwise API is preserved while `&` also remains available for a future unsafe/reference decision.

name: infix bitwise OR/or-pattern
failure_policy: reserved diagnostic outside approved domain grammar
description: Reserved because bitwise OR, or-patterns and conditional probability compete for the same code point.

name: prefix bitwise NOT
description: Method form remains canonical until infix/prefix bitwise syntax is intentionally activated.

name: shift left symbol
operand_rule: Int and bounded shift count candidate
description: Existing bounded method semantics are not automatically exposed as an infix operator.

name: shift right symbol
operand_rule: Int and bounded shift count candidate
description: Reserved until signed/logical right-shift profiles are unified beyond the current method contract.

name: general bracket indexing
description: General indexing remains RESERVED. NSR-RES-015-COMPAT-1.0.1 separately preserves bound immutable Array<Int,4> with a constant Int index; `.at()` is canonical. See NSR-RES-015-PUBLIC-1.0.1-COMPATIBILITY.json.

name: slice colon inside brackets
description: Reserved to avoid colliding with type and named-argument colon until a slice grammar is frozen.

name: address/reference prefix
operand_rule: lvalue with capability and lifetime proof
description: Never active in the safe core without an explicit unsafe/FFI contract.

name: dereference prefix
description: Binary `*` remains core multiplication; prefix dereference is reserved.

name: lambda introducer
description: Reserved because the existing callable syntax should not be duplicated without a migration decision.

name: mapping arrow
description: Reserved for a possible mathematically styled mapping syntax.

name: absolute-value delimiters
description: Reserved because `|` already competes with patterns, probability and potential bitwise syntax.

name: definition symbol
description: Reserved for formal definitions; not assignment or binding.

name: therefore/because proof symbols
description: Reserved for proof-report notation, not executable core expressions.

name: alternative pipeline
failure_policy: diagnostic with quick fix to receiver-first dot flow
description: Rejected because `.` is the canonical Nebo pipeline.

name: alternative bidirectional arrow
description: Rejected spelling; the historical candidate is `<.>`, itself still RESERVED.

name: alternative power
description: Rejected because `^` is the canonical power operator.

name: XOR interpretation of caret
failure_policy: typed diagnostic explaining power versus XOR
description: Caret is power only; XOR uses `xor`, `⊻` or the existing method.

name: increment
failure_policy: quick fix where semantics are safe
description: Rejected to keep mutation explicit and exactly-once.

name: decrement
failure_policy: quick fix where semantics are safe
description: Rejected to avoid C-style value-before/value-after ambiguity.

name: C-style ternary
canonical_ascii: if/else or a typed conditional method
description: Rejected in favor of explicit flow-first conditional constructs.

name: Elvis operator
description: Rejected because `??` has a precise Option meaning.

name: definition/assignment operator
description: Rejected because Nebo already separates value-first binding from assignment.

name: free comma sequencing
description: Comma remains a separator and never discards intermediate expression results as an operator.

name: single-equals comparison
failure_policy: quick fix to `==` when no assignment is intended
description: Single equals is assignment only.

name: legacy inequality
description: Rejected legacy spelling.

name: textual logical operators
description: Rejected to keep one ASCII core spelling plus optional mathematical Unicode aliases.

name: force unwrap or double factorial
description: Rejected because force unwrap and double factorial are incompatible meanings.

name: integer-division operator
failure_policy: lexer treats it as a comment
description: Line comments permanently own `//`; integer division uses `/` with typed operands.

name: alternative match/lambda arrow
description: The Assembly language uses `->` for bounded match arms; `=>` is not a second public spelling.

name: ASCII dot-dot range
failure_policy: quick fix to U+2026 or Range API
description: ASCII `..` is reserved for lateral flow and cannot also mean range.

name: pointer member arrow
description: Rejected from safe Nebo; `->` retains signature/match meaning.

name: implicit relative percentage addition
description: The language never guesses that adding a Percent means increasing the left value.

name: approximation with hidden epsilon
failure_policy: diagnostic requiring tolerance or Uncertain type
description: A global or target-dependent hidden epsilon is forbidden.

name: integral without report
description: Numerical integration must expose convergence and estimated error.

name: plus/minus tuple expansion
description: `±` constructs an uncertainty-bearing value, never an implicit pair.

name: implicit Text coercion
description: Text formatting must be explicit; arithmetic addition does not stringify values.

name: arbitrary custom operator
canonical_ascii: implement a known operator protocol or named method
description: User types may implement known protocols but may not invent symbols or precedence.

name: Unicode confusables
failure_policy: diagnostic prints code point and canonical replacement
description: Only explicitly registered Unicode aliases are accepted; NFKC/fullwidth lookalikes are rejected.

name: double-percent arithmetic
description: `%%` is only a literal-percent escape inside a validated format template.
